result.summary: The page is generally usable, but the promo banner has severely washed-out/low-contrast text, and some horizontally scrolling content is clipped at the right edge in a way that looks unintentional.

issues.description: The promotional banner text (“3 free deliveries for you”, code/minimum order details) is very low contrast against the pale green background and appears faded.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner text or add a stronger overlay/background so the offer, promo code, and conditions are clearly readable and meet contrast guidelines.

issues.description: The rightmost items in horizontal sections are visibly cut off, including the category chip after “Healthy” and the “Trattoria Piccol…” restaurant card/name.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel affordances, edge fade, or ensure partially visible cards do not truncate titles in a way that looks broken.

issues.description: Search placeholder text (“Restaurants, dishes, groceries”) is light gray and may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase placeholder contrast or use a darker neutral color while keeping it visually distinct from entered text.
